result.explanation: The order ord_0903 was paid once (payments:pay_0903, orders:ord_0903) but the grant process ran twice: the initial attempt timed out after writing the first grant row, and a manual retry created a second grant for the same email and reward (grants:g_ord_0903, grants:g_ord_0903_retry). This resulted in the customer receiving 60 credits twice.
result.customer_reply: Hi, we noticed that your order ord_0903 resulted in the 60‑credit reward being granted twice. We will remove the extra credit once we have approval; your original 60 credits remain valid. Please let us know if you have any questions.
result.fix_action: Revoke the duplicate grant (requires approval). Code fix: unique index on (email, reward_key, order_id); make the grant idempotent.

server_logs.message: grant batch timed out after 60s (row was written)
